resources.string: The start of Muharram has been confirmed in %2$s — Happy New Year.
%2$s has announced the start of Sha\'ban — time to prepare for Ramadan.
%2$s has announced the start of the blessed month of Ramadan — Ramadan Kareem.
%2$s has confirmed the start of Shawwal; Eid al-Fitr is tomorrow — Eid Mubarak.
%2$s has announced the start of Dhu al-Hijjah — the Day of Arafah and Eid al-Adha are near.
